  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0136.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np
borate='[B-](c1c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c1F)(c1c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c1F)(c1c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c1F)OC1=P[C@H](C(=O)OC)[C@@H]1C(=O)OC'
ligand='N(c1c(C(C)C)cccc1C(C)C)C(C)=CC(C)=N(c1c(C(C)C)cccc1C(C)C)'
a=Chem.MolFromSmiles(borate)
b=Chem.MolFromSmiles(ligand)
print('start atoms',a.GetNumAtoms(),b.GetNumAtoms())
for atom in a.GetAtoms():
 if atom.GetSymbol() in ['P','O']:
  print('A',atom.GetIdx(),atom.GetSymbol(), [(n.GetIdx(),n.GetSymbol(),str(a.GetBondBetweenAtoms(atom.GetIdx(),n.GetIdx()).GetBondType())) for n in atom.GetNeighbors()])
for atom in b.GetAtoms():
 if atom.GetSymbol()=='N': print('N',atom.GetIdx(),[(n.GetIdx(),n.GetSymbol()) for n in atom.GetNeighbors()])
combo=Chem.CombineMols(a,b)
w=Chem.RWMol(combo)
sn=Chem.Atom('Sn');sn.SetFormalCharge(1)
sni=w.AddAtom(sn)
base=a.GetNumAtoms()
# find O on carbonyl attached directly to P-ring C (P right neighbor)
p_idx=next(x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetAtoms() if x.GetSymbol()=='P')
r_idx=next(n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetAtomWithIdx(p_idx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C' and a.GetBondBetweenAtoms(p_idx,n.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
carbonyl_idx=next(n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetAtomWithIdx(r_idx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C' and any(a.GetBondBetweenAtoms(n.GetIdx(), o.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE and o.GetSymbol()=='O' for o in n.GetNeighbors()))
o_idx=next(o.GetIdx() for o in a.GetAtomWithIdx(carbonyl_idx).GetNeighbors() if o.GetSymbol()=='O' and a.GetBondBetweenAtoms(carbonyl_idx,o.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
ns=[x.GetIdx() for x in b.GetAtoms() if x.GetSymbol()=='N'];print('Sn coord O',o_idx,'N',ns,'Sn idx',sni)
w.AddBond(base+ns[0],sni,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
w.AddBond(base+ns[1],sni,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
w.AddBond(o_idx,sni,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=w.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
print('combined',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('all',m.GetNumAtoms())
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=20;params.maxIterations=1200;params.useRandomCoords=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed result',res,flush=True)
if res == -1: quit()
print('uff?',AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m), flush=True)
try:
 ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m, ignoreInterfragInteractions=False);print('uff energy before',ff.CalcEnergy());ff.Minimize(maxIts=700);print('uff after',ff.CalcEnergy(),flush=True)
except Exception as e:print('UFF fail',e)
conf=m.GetConformer()
pt=lambda i: np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))
left=next(n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetAtomWithIdx(p_idx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C' and n.GetIdx()!=r_idx)
bottom=next(n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetAtomWithIdx(r_idx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C' and n.GetIdx()!=p_idx and n.GetIdx()!=carbonyl_idx)
ester_bottom=next(n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetAtomWithIdx(bottom).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C' and n.GetIdx()!=r_idx and n.GetIdx()!=left)
normal=np.cross(pt(r_idx)-pt(p_idx),pt(bottom)-pt(p_idx));print('stereofaces:', np.dot(normal,pt(carbonyl_idx)-pt(r_idx)),np.dot(normal,pt(ester_bottom)-pt(bottom)))
with open('prelim.xyz','w') as out:
 out.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nCoordinated phosphacyclobutene borate stannylene (UFF/ETKDG)\n')
 for atom in m.GetAtoms():
  pos=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx());out.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {pos.x: .8f} {pos.y: .8f} {pos.z: .8f}\n')
PY
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python build.py > build.log 2>&1; cat build.log; ls -l prelim.xyz

from pathlib import Path
for f in ['prelim.xyz','xtb_opt/xtbopt.log','xtb_opt/xtbopt.xyz']:
 if not Path(f).exists():continue
 lines=Path(f).read_text().splitlines();n=int(lines[0]);last=lines[-n:];a=np.array([[float(k) for k in x.split()[1:]] for x in last]);print(f,'frames',len(lines)//(n+2),'last/comment:',lines[-n-1] if len(lines)%(n+2)==0 else 'not full')
 for i,j in [(36,35),(36,37),(37,42),(37,38),(38,39),(39,78),(47,78),(65,78),(0,34),(0,1)]:print(i,j,round(np.linalg.norm(a[i]-a[j]),2),end='; ')
 print();normal=np.cross(a[37]-a[36],a[42]-a[36]);print('ring stereofaces',np.dot(normal,a[38]-a[37]),np.dot(normal,a[43]-a[42]))
PY
